stories.title: Jacobs put on exempt list as Pack trade for RB
stories.summary: The NFL has placed Packers running back Josh Jacobs on the commissioner exempt list.

stories.title: Sources: Broncos' Cooper placed on exempt list
stories.summary: The NFL is placing Broncos outside linebacker Jonathon Cooper on the commissioner exempt list following a pair of arrests earlier this summer on domestic violence charges.

stories.title: Titans parting ways with QB Levis, sources say
stories.summary: The Titans are waiving quarterback Will Levis, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Colts WR Allen arrested on drunk driving charges
stories.summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was arrested early Sunday morning on drunken driving charges.

stories.title: Source: Undrafted rookie lands Bucs' QB2 role
stories.summary: The Buccaneers have decided that Jalon Daniels, an undrafted rookie free agent, will be their backup quarterback to start the season, a source told NFL Network.
